title: TraceKV: Policy-Preserving Low-Rank KV Cache Compression for Reasoning Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.15569v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reasoning vision-language models (VLMs) impose substantial KV cache demands from both large multimodal contexts and growing reasoning traces. Low-rank KV compression has emerged as a promising paradigm that stores low-dimensional latents of KV states and can be combined with quantization. However, existing low-rank methods often induce growing predictive policy drift from the dense model when compressing reasoning KV states, resulting in reasoning failures. We identify two key causes of this degradation: calibration-state mismatch between static contexts and on-policy reasoning states, and unequal error sensitivity across KV states. To address these challenges, we propose TraceKV, a training-free low-rank KV compression framework that unifies on-policy calibration, sensitivity-aware SVD, and global rank allocation under a single policy-preserving principle, substantially reducing policy-KL divergence during reasoning. translated_title: TraceKV：面向推理型视觉语言模型的策略保持低秩KV缓存压缩
translated_abstract: 推理型视觉语言模型（VLM）在大型多模态上下文和不断增长的推理轨迹两方面都带来了巨大的KV缓存需求。低秩KV压缩已成为一种有前景的范式，它存储KV状态低维潜变量，并可与量化相结合。然而，现有低秩方法在压缩推理KV状态时，往往会引起与稠密模型相比不断加剧的预测策略漂移，导致推理失败。我们识别出这种性能退化的两个关键原因：一是静态上下文与在线推理状态之间的校准状态不匹配，二是KV状态之间的误差敏感性不均衡。为应对这些挑战，我们提出TraceKV——一个免训练的低秩KV压缩框架，它在统一的策略保持原则下整合了在线策略校准、敏感性感知SVD和全局秩分配，在推理过程中大幅降低了策略KL散度。实验在……（原文截断）
tldr: TraceKV是一个免训练的低秩KV缓存压缩框架，通过统一在线策略校准、敏感性感知SVD和全局秩分配的策略保持原则，解决了推理型视觉语言模型中KV压缩引起的策略漂移问题，显著降低推理时的策略KL散度。
en_tdlr: TraceKV is a training-free low-rank KV cache compression framework that preserves the dense model's policy in reasoning VLMs by unifying on-policy calibration, sensitivity-aware SVD, and global rank allocation, substantially reducing policy-KL divergence during reasoning.
